\documentclass[12pt,border=10pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{blogfigure}
\begin{document}
% x scale: unit interval drawn 13cm wide. Segment styling shared with context-moves-partition.
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=13cm,y=1cm,
  seg odd/.style={fill=paper,draw=ink},
  seg even/.style={draw=ink,figure halftone},
  face/.style={fill=paper,inner sep=1.5pt}]
  \FigureMasthead{-0.1}{1.02}{5.25}{}{}
  % table
  \foreach \k/\p [count=\i] in {1/0.05,2/0.10,3/0.15,4/0.20,5/0.20,6/0.30} {
    \pgfmathsetmacro\cx{(\i-0.5)/6}
    \node (f\i) at (\cx,3.6) {\k};
    \node[font=\FigureNoteFont] (p\i) at (\cx,2.95) {$\p$};
  }
  \draw[figure rule thin] (0.02,3.25) -- (0.98,3.25);
  \node[figure note,anchor=east] at (-0.01,3.6) {face};
  \node[figure note,anchor=east] at (-0.01,2.95) {prob.};
  % segments
  \foreach \a/\b/\k [count=\i] in {0/.05/1,.05/.15/2,.15/.30/3,.30/.50/4,.50/.70/5,.70/1/6} {
    \ifodd\i \draw[seg odd] (\a,0) rectangle (\b,0.8);
    \else \draw[seg even] (\a,0) rectangle (\b,0.8); \fi
    \node[face] at ({(\a+\b)/2 - (\i==4)*0.04},0.4) {\k};
    \pgfmathsetmacro\cx{(\i-0.5)/6}
    \draw[muted,line width=.45pt] (\cx,2.6) -- ({(\a+\b)/2},0.85);
  }
  \draw[line width=1.4pt] (0,0) rectangle (1,0.8);
  % boundary ticks
  \foreach \t/\l/\dx in {0/0/-3pt,.05/.05/5pt,.15/.15/0pt,.30/.30/0pt,.50/.50/0pt,.70/.70/0pt,1/1/0pt}
    \draw (\t,0) -- (\t,-0.15) node[below,font=\FigureNoteFont,inner sep=2pt,xshift=\dx] {$\l$};
  % draw at u=0.42
  \draw[line width=2pt] (0.42,-0.1) -- (0.42,0.95);
  \node[anchor=west] at (0.43,-1.0) {$u=0.42$};
  \draw[figure emph arrow] (0.42,-0.15) -- (0.42,-1.35);
  \node[figure box,figure solid,text width=,minimum width=14mm,minimum height=10mm,anchor=north] at (0.42,-1.4) {\textbf{4}};
  \FigureFootRule{-0.1}{1.02}{-2.75}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
